name: Purwokerto
scopeLimits: The ranked WUP point is a population-weighted Purwokerto locator, not a parcel identity. Official BHUMI viewer JavaScript exposes the `umum:Persil` “Bidang Tanah” layer under `/bhumigs/umum`; help describes registered parcel polygons and NIB/Hak/area details. The local identify method calls an Authorization-token `expapi/getPersil` path. No token, login, identify call or property attributes were used. Direct guessed unauthenticated WMS/WFS URLs returned 404. PENA MAS covers only Banyumas government land assets.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
registryBasis: The official ATR/BPN Banyumas office handles local land registration, and the official BHUMI national interactive map advertises a registered “Bidang Tanah” layer. Banyumas Regency’s PENA MAS GIS is only a government-owned land asset inventory, not general private cadastral coverage.
technicalBlocker: The viewer’s public map layer is discoverable, but the official JS routes parcel identify through an Authorization-token endpoint; direct anonymous WMS/WFS probes at the documented service path returned 404. No safe public geometry query was established.
remainingUncertainty: Whether BHUMI offers a public full-geometry export or service path independent of authenticated identify; registered parcel coverage at the exact WUP point is unverified.
nextStep: Wait for an officially documented anonymous geometry endpoint or public service description before querying parcel geometry.

officialSources.observation: Official ATR/BPN BHUMI interactive-map shell (HTTP 200); public HTML loads map JS.
Official BHUMI help says the interactive map publishes ATR/BPN spatial data through the ATLAS geoportal.
Official map help describes parcel (“bidang tanah”) layer, coordinate/legend tools, and identifying a parcel using NIB/Hak/NIBEL.
Official Banyumas ATR/BPN office publication confirms the local land office and registration processes in Kabupaten Banyumas.
Banyumas Regency official PENA MAS GIS maps government-owned land assets in Purwokerto subdistricts only; not a private cadastral register.
